CEL native int/double/string Map overloads, setSame and date equality now have retained public-adapter tests; browser native Map case also exercises integer/fractional/string key distinctions.
scopeLimits: Core interpreter/UI-model semantics only; renderer-specific DOM or visual behavior is outside these acceptance checks.
No new Action source change was made by the acceptance-test owner; concrete defects were repaired by root.
